publication.publisher_or_container: Loeb Classical Library / Harvard University Press (Perseus Digital Library text)
publication.edition: Letters written 62-43 BCE; collected and published by Tiro after 43 BCE; Loeb translation 1928

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the 16-book collection of letters to friends/family, the 62-43 BCE span, publication by Cicero's freedman Tiro, and the Loeb/Perseus edition. Latin original public domain; technique described, no text reproduced.

limitations: Roman epistolary conventions differ from modern informal letters; the 'familiar' register is not identical to contemporary conversational prose.

copyright.notes: Latin text public domain; the 1928 Loeb translation may be copyrighted and is not reproduced.
